educational_overlay.purpose: Constructs an objective, date-ordered factual timeline from pleadings, contracts, WhatsApp transcripts, and email correspondence.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: When preparing plaints, written statements, bail petitions, or commercial court briefs from voluminous disorganized documents.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: When assessing abstract legal principles where chronological sequence of facts is irrelevant.

variables.label: Case Reference
variables.default: Commercial Suit for Recovery of Contractual Dues

educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Extract chronological fact table for matter '{{CASE_MATTER}}' covering '{{KEY_DATE_RANGE}}'.
For each event record: Exact Date, Source Document, Parties Involved, Factual Event, and Disputed vs Admitted Status.
Identify gaps where dates are ambiguous or corroborating documentary evidence is missing.
Mark missing exhibits with [MISSING DOCUMENT].
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: A construction subcontractor has 150 email exchanges, 12 signed change orders, and 4 WhatsApp chat logs documenting delayed site handovers.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### Litigation Chronology Matrix
| Date | Source Doc | Event Description | Evidentiary Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 Jan 2025 | Agreement Ex. P-1 | Work order executed for Rs. 2.5 Cr | Admitted |
| 10 Mar 2025 | Email Ex. P-2 | Site handover delayed by employer | Disputed |
guardrails: Never extrapolate assumed dates when documents lack timestamps.
verification_checklist: Cross-check electronic timestamps against electronic evidence certificates.
Confirm chronological sequence aligns with limitation cut-off.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: OCR errors in scanned documents often lead to mistaken digits in years and dates.
